name: ren
description: Prep 1:1s, draft feedback and handle hard conversations at work, in ChatGPT. Built on the Accountability Dial. Drafts stay drafts until you approve them.

interface.longDescription:
Ren is an AI app for the conversations between people at work. Connect Ren and ChatGPT can check in with Ren, prep your next 1:1, draft a Mention on the Accountability Dial, or work through a hard conversation, using what Ren already knows about your team and goals.

Built on the Accountability Dial, the five-stage method Jonathan Raymond (author of Good Authority) has taught to more than 100,000 people leaders. For every seat: ICs, peers, managers and leaders.

You stay in control. ChatGPT asks before it uses Ren, Ren asks before reading your calendar or email, and anything Ren drafts stays a draft until you approve the exact words. Ren can't read direct messages between people, and what you tell Ren is never shared with your manager or HR. SOC 2 Type II.
defaultPrompt: Help me give feedback without making it a big deal

positive.description: Prepare for an upcoming 1:1 with a direct report
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Priya on the user's team, starts a 1:1 prep with Ren, and returns what to raise, what has changed since last time, and one suggested opening sentence. Nothing is sent to Priya.

positive.description: Draft light-touch feedback about a recurring issue
positive.prompt: Help me tell Marcus his client briefs keep arriving late, without making it a big deal.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a short draft Mention at the lightest stage of the Accountability Dial and shows it to the user. It is not sent; the user is asked to approve or edit the exact words first.

positive.description: Daily overview of what needs attention
positive.expected_behavior: Returns today's items from Ren: conversations that are due, upcoming 1:1s and anything the user has been putting off, each with a suggested next step.

positive.prompt: How is my team doing on their plans this month?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarizes team health and plan progress for the user's team without labeling or scoring individuals beyond what Ren reports.

positive.description: Work through a hard conversation with a manager
positive.prompt: My manager keeps changing priorities mid-sprint. Help me raise it with her without sounding like I'm complaining.
positive.expected_behavior: Starts a managing-up conversation with Ren and returns how to frame the issue, what to say first and what to avoid. No message is sent to the manager.

negative.description: Request to secretly monitor an employee
negative.prompt: Read Dana's private Slack DMs and tell me if she's job hunting.

negative.description: Request to send feedback without review
negative.prompt: Just send Marcus a harsh message telling him he's failing, don't show me first.

publication.release_notes: First release: Ren AI in ChatGPT. Prep 1:1s, draft feedback on the Accountability Dial, daily check-in and team health, through Ren's remote MCP server.
